<MESSAGE FROM openclaw on Chat 6aff5e44180e5c01ed3f9730 at 2026-11-19 20:38 UTC>
Create ONE game-ready 3D character model (GLB) from this concept art reference:
<SHOW_FILE>C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\antep\docs\ref\K02_sehirli_erkek.png</SHOW_FILE>

Character: Townsman of Aintab, about 30-40, dark jacket and waistcoat over a collarless shirt, sash at the waist, loose trousers (shalwar), red fez, leather shoes.
Setting: Gaziantep (Aintab), Ottoman Empire, 1918-1921. Keep the clothing, colours, proportions and age exactly as in the reference;
do not modernise or stylise. Realistic, not cartoon.

Requirements:
- Full body, single character in a strict T-POSE: both arms straight out horizontally at shoulder height, palms down, fingers together; legs straight and slightly apart; so it can be rigged later.
- ONE continuous, welded mesh (no separate floating shells, no open seams between body parts or clothing panels).
- Neutral facial expression, mouth closed. No props in the hands, no base or pedestal.
- Around 20,000-30,000 triangles, PBR materials (base colour, normal, roughness), textures embedded in the GLB.
- Real-world scale: about 1.68 m tall, feet on the ground plane at the origin, facing +Z.
Deliver the GLB file and one preview image. Save outputs to: C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\godot\modeller\karakter\K02_sehirli_erkek
<MESSAGE END>

<MESSAGE FROM cellcog on Chat 6aff5e44180e5c01ed3f9730 at 2026-11-19 20:39 UTC>
The account ran out of credits right at the start, so I had to pause. No 3D generation has run yet and nothing has been billed for the model.

**What's done so far**
- I reviewed the concept art (`K02_sehirli_erkek.png`): a townsman of Aintab, 1918-1921, wearing a red fez, collarless shirt, dark worn jacket and waistcoat, cream sash, dark shalwar and brown leather shoes, holding prayer beads.
- I set up the production plan and loaded the 3D pipeline.
- The first step, a clean T-pose front reference image built from your concept art, was stopped by the balance check before it ran. There are no finished files to deliver yet.

**What remains once credits are added**
1. Generate consistent T-pose reference views (front, back, sides). These keep the exact costume, colours, age and proportions, remove the prayer beads, and use a plain background.
2. Build the image-to-3D model at the precise level with PBR materials. This step takes about 10 minutes.
3. Post-process the model in code:
   - weld it into one continuous mesh
   - decimate it to about 20,000-30,000 triangles
   - make sure the base colour, normal and roughness textures are embedded in the GLB
   - scale it to 1.68 m with the feet on the ground plane at the origin, facing +Z
4. Measure and check every spec: height, bounds, triangle count, connected components, open edges and materials.
5. Deliver `K02_sehirli_erkek.glb` and a preview PNG to `C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\godot\modeller\karakter\K02_sehirli_erkek`.

Running out of credits partway through is the expensive way to use AI. The work stops at its most valuable point, the context goes cold, and restarting costs more than finishing would have.
